title: Normal call: a daughter, from her saved number, about groceries

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Dad! I'm at the store, do you still need milk and the blood pressure tablets?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Got it. It's about forty dollars, you can pay me back on Sunday at lunch, no rush.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Love you, I'll drop it by tonight.
